A.what_i_gave_up: I originally wanted no strong-smelling food cooked in the flat at all. I gave that up for an agreement on timing and frequency.
A.what_i_got: I got an agreement that the cooking would happen after 7 p.m., which means the smell won't be there during my work video calls.
A.what_was_agreed: Sarah will cook her strong-smelling food after 7 p.m., only once a week, and on a Tuesday or Thursday.
A.why_i_went_along: Because my main problem was the smell affecting my work, and Sarah agreeing to cook after 7 p.m. completely solved that for me.

B.what_i_gave_up: I gave up on completely eliminating the cooking smell from my room. It will now happen once a week instead of twice.
B.what_i_got: The frequency of the strong cooking smell was reduced by half, from twice a week to once a week.
B.what_still_bothers_me: The smell will still get into my room once a week. It's not completely gone.
B.what_was_agreed: Sarah will cook her strong-smelling food only once a week, after 7 p.m., on either a Tuesday or a Thursday.
B.why_i_went_along: It was a good compromise. Sarah can't just stop cooking her food, and we can't change the kitchen. Reducing the smell from two days a week to one day a week was a big improvement for me, so I accepted it.

D.why_i_went_along: Because the most important thing for me was being able to cook my food at all. How often I cook it is less important. It felt like a fair trade-off to keep the peace.
